"anim" : "fadedrop", "dur" : 300 }, "items" : "voidanim" } } } Great Wines of the World, Beijing 2018 November 5 Great Wines of the World 2018 – Beijing Monday, November 5, 2018; Rosewood Beijing Grand Tasting — 2:30 p.m. to 6 p.m. Taste the world’s greatest wines at this one-day-only wine tasting extravaganza with James Suckling!
Considered as the wine event of the year, Great Wines of the World will return to Beijing on November 5 at Rosewood Beijing. Featuring 100+ of the best producers from the top wine regions in the world — all handpicked by James Suckling — the event will showcase an extraordinary selection of more than 220 outstanding wines from the world’s most renowned vineyards and boutique wineries. Their celebrated owners and winemakers will be personally in attendance, presenting two top vintages for you to taste and sharing their valuable insights with you.
All wines available to taste have scored a minimum of 90 points by James Suckling, with more than half of them with a score of 95 points and above. And it does not stop there: at the grand tasting, you will get the chance to taste 10 perfect-scoring, 100-point wines ! No wine event has ever made this level of quality accessible in China, showcasing the best of the best of the world’s top wine regions. 13 of the world’s most important wine regions on showcase All 200 wines available to taste have scored a minimum of 90 points by wine critic James Suckling Savor 10 perfect-scoring 100 Point wines across a variety of styles Enjoy delectable bites from the culinary team of Rosewood Beijing while listening to sleek tunes by award-winning Australian recording artist Surahn Sidhu Get a taste of the event by watching last year’s video here
Early bird tickets are now on sale at a special price of RMB 588 only (on or before October 9, or while stock lasts; regular price RMB 788) . All members of the wine trade are invited to sign up for our trade tasting session, and this applies to wine importers, distributors, retailers, restaurant owners, sommeliers, hotel F&B directors. _
